data.long_meaning: Derived from the Greek word 'ánnia', which means 'grace' or 'mercy'. In Christian tradition, Anny is associated with the Virgin Mary and the grace she bestowed upon humanity. The name Anny carries the meaning “Grace, mercy” and is chosen by families in Christian traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Biblical tradition and is also used in English, Greek, Latin. Parents who choose Anny usually hope their child will grow to embody grace, mercy and live with faith, good character and purpose.
